summary: Iteration 9 follow-up: verified /api/health returns 503 when DB ping fails and 200 when healthy. Regression smoke on OTP, dashboard, settlements (worker+contractor), feedback, and 30x concurrent /api/health all passed. 9/9 pytest tests green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1500+ lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, workers, settlements, health, payments) for maintainability.
FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') is deprecated; migrate to lifespan handlers (multiple DeprecationWarnings observed).
/api/health returns raw str(e)[:200] on failure — fine for dev but consider redacting connection strings if the exception ever includes them.
test_credentials: Mobile OTP dev flow (dev_otp returned in /api/auth/otp/send response).
seed_data_creation: TEST_Iter9 workers/contractors/feedback created and deleted within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iteration9_health_503.py covers healthy 200 (public URL), simulated DB-down 503 via in-process ASGI (replaces server.client with a stub whose admin.command awaits into ServerSelectionTimeoutError), exception-handler registration, 30x concurrent health, and regression smoke (OTP/dashboard/settlements/feedback). Note: motor's client.admin returns a fresh proxy each access, so patch.object on server.client.admin.command does NOT work — must replace server.client entirely (see test file).
rca of the issue: N/A — reviewer feedback (503 on DB failure) is correctly implemented in server.py lines 1450-1463 using JSONResponse(status_code=503, ...); JSONResponse import already at top of file.
